objective: repair the failed cross-lab uncertainty transfer without tuning on the already-opened GSE132044 test labels: calibrate on one new laboratory and evaluate exactly once on a second untouched laboratory, while preserving the original GSE96583 classifier weights and fit-donor feature set

prior_result.reason_new_labs_are_required: the original Broad test labels have been inspected, so changing calibration and reusing Broad as a confirmatory test would be circular

calibration_lab.declared_modality: 3-prime CITE-seq RNA counts with author cell annotations; ADT is retained as provenance but cannot enter this RNA classifier

untouched_confirmation_lab.declared_design: individual-donor PBMC samples from control and AMD participants

frozen_input_policy.expression: raw integer gene-by-cell counts only; refuse normalized or integrated expression as classifier input
frozen_input_policy.gene_alignment: exact case-sensitive HGNC symbol intersection with the 508 genes stored in pbmc_cross_lab_model.npz; no new feature selection
frozen_input_policy.normalization: per-cell library size to 10000 followed by log1p, identical to the original model
frozen_input_policy.duplicate_gene_symbol_policy: use the first released row in source order and report all duplicates

ambiguous_label_policy.author_labels_outside_the_six_class_onto: exclude from classifier metrics and retain as semantic OOD only

allowed_fitted_quantities: one positive scalar temperature minimizing calibration-label negative log likelihood
six class-conditional split-conformal nonconformity thresholds at alpha 0.1
calibration_contract.nonconformity_score: one minus calibrated probability assigned to the true class
calibration_contract.finite_sample_quantile: ceil((n_class + 1) * 0.9)-th ordered score, capped at n_class

confirmation_contract.primary_population: author-designated control participants only; if no control condition column/value exists, use all participants and report this fallback before evaluation

failure_policy.if_any_primary_endpoint_fails: retain PBMC head as blocked_external_uncertainty and do not reuse confirmation labels
failure_policy.if_required_columns_or_raw_counts_are_ab: refuse source rather than infer labels or substitute integrated expression
failure_policy.if_confirmation_fails: select a new protocol and a new untouched laboratory before another confirmatory claim

authority.required_after_pass: validated Aleph observation operator plus identifiability and monotonic forward sensitivity before numeric promotion
